description: A jq clone focused on correctness and performance

option.name: --arg
tip: Set variable $A to string V

option.name: --argjson
tip: Set variable $A to JSON value V

option.name: --args
tip: Collect remaining positional arguments into $ARGS.positional

option.name: --color-output
tip: Always color output

option.name: --compact-output
tip: Print JSON compactly, omitting whitespace

option.name: --exit-status
tip: Use the last output value as exit status code

option.name: --from
tip: Read input in given format

option.name: --from-file
tip: Read filter from a file

option.name: --help
tip: Print help

option.name: --in-place
tip: Overwrite input file with its output

option.name: --indent
tip: Use N spaces for indentation

option.name: --join-output
tip: Do not print a newline after each value

option.name: --library-path
tip: Search for modules in given directory

option.name: --monochrome-output
tip: Do not color output

option.name: --null-input
tip: Use null as single input value

option.name: --raw-input
tip: Read lines of the input as sequence of strings

option.name: --raw-input0
tip: Read input like -R, splitting by NUL instead of newlines

option.name: --raw-output
tip: Write strings without escaping them with quotes

option.name: --raw-output0
tip: Write output like -r and print NUL after each output

option.name: --rawfile
tip: Set variable $A to string from file F

option.name: --run-tests
tip: Run tests from a file

option.name: --slurp
tip: Read all input values into one array

option.name: --slurpfile
tip: Set variable $A to array from JSON file F

option.name: --sort-keys
tip: Print objects sorted by their keys

option.name: --tab
tip: Use tabs for indentation rather than spaces

option.name: --to
tip: Write output in given format

option.name: --version
tip: Print version
